findings.description: The regex check was changed from `match` to `fullmatch`, so a pattern that previously matched a prefix of the exception message now has to match the whole message.
findings.rationale: Trigger: `match="timeout"` with an exception message like "timeout after 5s". `re.match` returned True and retried. `fullmatch` returns False, so retries silently stop. Existing users who pass prefix patterns see a behavior change that the empty-string handling fix does not call for.
